memory.text: I saw a seal mark change whose grain was whose.
I took something that was not mine and let another bear the blame.

pr76 test, of the walls.

Uruk · c. 3200 BCE

Born within the walls, where every neighbor knew whose child you were and what the family had done last winter.

Indebted to a household that expected repayment in favors as well as grain.

Understood in one afternoon that the mark pressed in clay mattered more than whoever pressed it.

Took what was not to be taken, and let another bear the blame.

Placed by family, who counted what they spent.

Lodged under Utu-mansum at the gate, where every mark had to be defended to an angry boatman.

Drawn toward work involving security, custody, and the safe movement of people and resources.

The clerk called the habit pliable.
